description: Records visual proof while testing UI behavior — the agent tests the app hands-on via computer use while a screen recording with structured test/assertion annotations captures the session — then posts the video and a results summary to the requested destination. Use when changed runtime behavior needs observable verification, including headless environments (scripted screenshots and probes) and non-UI changes (measured numbers, output pairs).
